love.summary: Most readers sense a significant romantic shift ahead for Capricorn, whether through a promising new connection or meaningful emotional growth, so open your heart and allow past wounds to heal rather than hold you back.
love.disagreement: Some readers focused on an exciting new romantic arrival, while others pointed to emotional strain or disconnection within an existing bond.

finance.summary: A major financial turning point appears to be on the horizon for Capricorn, so take time to weigh your options carefully before committing, as thoughtful preparation now is likely to lead to a rewarding outcome.
finance.disagreement: Some readers saw hardship ending and abundance arriving, while others suggested Capricorn is still in early stages of planning or exploring a new opportunity, not yet at a resolution.

career.summary: All five readers point to a promising new professional opportunity taking shape this week, so lean into the momentum by staying organized, solution-focused, and open to things moving faster than expected.
career.disagreement: Some readers saw the opportunity arriving quickly and almost immediately, while others suggested it is still in early negotiation or preparation stages before a favorable outcome lands.

family.summary: Only a few readers touched on family this week, but those who did pointed to gatherings, reunions, and a supportive network of loved ones as sources of meaningful connection and joy for Capricorn.
family.disagreement: No notable disagreement among readers who discussed this theme.

overall_tone_summary: Quiet introspection shapes the week, inviting Capricorn to look inward.
